title: BTS Return to MetLife Stadium With a Full ARIRANG World Tour Show: 15 Best Moments
summary: Two weeks after their World Cup Final Halftime Show performance in the same stadium, BTS gave New Jersey the complete two-and-a-half-hour version.
contentText:
Less than two weeks ago, the world watched BTS take the field at MetLife Stadium for the first-ever World Cup Final Halftime Show, performing “Dynamite” on a bill alongside fellow global superstars Madonna, Shakira, Coldplay and Justin Bieber. It was an all-too-short flex of the septet’s showmanship with the few minutes reminding the world why they belonged on the planet’s biggest stage.

On Saturday, Aug. 1, BTS returned to the same venue with two and a half hours to show what they could really do. Night 1 of BTS’ MetLife run was a near-nonstop ARIRANG showcase with nearly every song from the multi-week Billboard 200 chart-topper performed plus some classic hits and fan favorites. The guys only paused mostly to thank ARMY for showing up and turning up. Absent was any direct extension of the collective statement the members issued earlier this week announcing they would not submit their music to this year’s Grammy Awards . ARMY, however, had plenty to say, and those messages made it to the jumbotron. (Read on for those messages)

BTS kept things cheerful instead, with RM telling the crowd, “Whatever’s next, guys, ARMY’s, I want to stay positive. I will never take this love for granted. I hope you had a great time tonight, I love you so much,” before blowing a kiss.

Throughout the night, RM along with Jin, Suga, J-Hope, Jimin, V and Jung Kook repeatedly framed the night as the start of the world tour’s second North American leg. After a second MetLife date on Sunday, Aug. 2, BTS head to Boston and ultimately close the leg with a four-night stand at Los Angeles’ SoFi Stadium in September before heading off to other continents.

From the beautiful celebrations of Korean culture to a Nas shoutout, read on for our 15 favorite moments of the first night at MetLife Stadium in BTS’ ARIRANG World Tour.
